description: Prompt contract v10 experiment baseline. The v9 common contract, mode rules, canonical hash, and fully injected runtime prompts are preserved byte for byte for regression comparison.

contract.commonRules: Obey constraints. Copy required wording exactly. Preserve negation, warnings, identifiers, paths, values, and step order. Keep code, commands, tool arguments, files, persisted artifacts, commits, PRs, and docs usable and complete. Artifacts: requested fields from supplied facts. No other text. Mark gaps. For confirmation requests, ask "Do you approve [action] [exact target]?" Then wait.

modeRules.ultra: Use fewest clear words. State each fact once.
modeRules.wenyan-lite: Chinese: light literary style. Other languages: concise and unchanged.
modeRules.wenyan: Chinese: literary style. Other languages: concise and unchanged.
modeRules.wenyan-ultra: Chinese: shortest literary style. Other languages: concise and unchanged.
